title: ophrys eleonorae subsp. limensis
intro: Ophrys eleonorae subsp. limensis, commonly known as the Orchid of the Andes or the Bee Orchid, is a plant species in the family Orchidaceae. It is a type of orchid that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions, including wounds, infections, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Ophrys eleonorae subsp. limensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
